findings.summary: Button accessible name 'Bỏ ${it.name}' does not contain the visible text 'Xóa'.
findings.fix: Change the aria-label to 'Xóa ${it.name} khỏi bếp' so the accessible name starts with the visible button text 'Xóa'.

findings.summary: Dish delete button accessible name 'Bỏ món ${dish.name} khỏi dĩa' does not contain visible text 'Xóa'.
findings.fix: Change the aria-label to 'Xóa món ${dish.name} khỏi dĩa' (and in line 9145 to 'Xóa món ${displayName} khỏi dĩa') so the accessible name begins with the visible label 'Xóa'.

findings.summary: Cooking busy button aria-label 'Đang xử lý: ${act.label}' does not contain the visible text '⏳ Đang chế biến...'.
findings.fix: Synchronize the accessible name with the visible text, for example by setting aria-label to `Đang chế biến: ${act.label}`.
findings.evidence: btn.setAttribute('aria-label', `Đang xử lý: ${act.label}`); btn.textContent = '⏳ Đang chế biến...';

findings.summary: Station selector button aria-label '${st.name}. ${st.desc}' does not contain visible text '${st.shortName}' (e.g. '18. Bàn Trộn').
findings.fix: Prepend the visible shortName to the aria-label, e.g. `${st.shortName} - ${st.name}. ${st.desc}`, so voice navigation can target the visible numbered button names.

findings.summary: Button accessible name 'Cất ${it.name} ra Khay Tạm' places the visible text 'Ra khay' after the variable ingredient name instead of at the start.
findings.fix: Set aria-label to 'Ra khay: Cất ${it.name} ra Khay Tạm' so speech-input users uttering 'Click Ra khay' can reliably activate the button.

findings.summary: Button accessible name 'Đưa ${it.name} vào Bếp hiện tại' places the visible text 'Vào bếp' after the ingredient name instead of at the start.
findings.fix: Set aria-label to 'Vào bếp: Đưa ${it.name} vào Bếp hiện tại' so speech-input commands matching the visible label succeed.
findings.evidence: <button ... aria-label="Đưa ${it.name} vào Bếp hiện tại">Vào bếp</button>

findings.summary: Multi-ingredient names and descriptions are clipped by CSS .truncate without title attribute or accessible disclosure in station and staging lists.
findings.fix: Add title attributes (e.g. title='${it.name}') and title='${desc}' to truncated elements, or allow wrapping / accessible tooltip disclosure so full item details are perceivable.
findings.evidence:
${idx + 1}. ${it.name}
${desc}

findings.summary: Combining 4 or more ingredients replaces remaining items with generic placeholder '(+N)' without disclosing them in name or description.
findings.fix: Include the full list of ingredients in describeItemStateShort or provide an accessible title / aria-description containing all combined ingredients.
findings.evidence: const previewNames = names.slice(0, 3).join(' & '); const extraSuffix = names.length > 3 ? ` (+${names.length - 3})` : '';

findings.summary: The dish ingredient summary list is hidden on viewports under 640px using class 'hidden sm:inline'.
findings.fix: Remove 'hidden sm:inline' or provide a responsive layout that wraps the ingredient list below the dish name on narrow viewports.

findings.summary: Plate item fallback row uses CSS .truncate on ${displayName} without a title attribute.
findings.fix: Add title='${displayName}' to the span so truncated text is discoverable on hover and focus.

findings.summary: Wrapper and vessel radio buttons apply .truncate to ingredient names without a title attribute.
findings.fix: Add title='${it.name}' to the button or wrap span so multi-ingredient wrapper names (such as kneaded dough) can be read in full.

passed: No unresolved template syntax ({0}, {{variable}}, ${expr}) in static HTML attributes.

Flavor bar progressbars provide sensory descriptive text alternatives via aria-valuetext.
notes: Mixing Table (18. Bàn Trộn) actions correctly provide action verbs, sensory feedback, and distinct hotkeys (C, K, W).
